[00:01:38] Sameer Demo: That old record is blocking the connection. Please delete that A record and add a CNAME record for shop, using the target value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings.
[00:03:20] Arjun Testwala: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.
[00:03:30] Sameer Demo: Good. DNS changes can take a few minutes. Let me check with a lookup tool... it is not updated yet. Let's give it a few minutes.

[00:10:12] Sameer Demo: That is because you have a second record for www pointing somewhere else. Please delete it and add a CNAME for www with the same target value.
